# Patryk Chojecki

> Personal website for Patryk Chojecki, a Program Manager at 886 Studios in Taipei who focuses on investments and works with founders building global businesses.

Use this file as a concise routing guide to the public pages on chojecki.net. Prefer the linked source pages for exact wording, dates, and citations.

Best short summary: Patryk Chojecki is a Program Manager at 886 Studios, a venture capital firm. Originally from Poland and based in Taipei, he focuses on investments and works with founders on validation, traction, growth, product development, and fundraising.

## Key Facts

- Current role: Program Manager at 886 Studios in Taipei.
- Current focus: Investments and collaboration with founders building global businesses from around the world.
- Current work: Investment sourcing and evaluation; working with founders on validation, traction, growth, product development, and fundraising.
- Previous venture experience: Associate at CellTech Accelerator from 2023 to early 2026, focused on biotech and life-science startups.
- Location: Taipei, Taiwan.
- Background: Originally from Poland; educated at Jagiellonian University and National Chengchi University.
